SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '1' THEN 1 END) as generalCargoCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '2' THEN 1 END) as hazardousTransportCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '3' THEN 1 END) as smallVehicleCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '4' THEN 1 END) as emergencyVehicleCount FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.clsstx
deleted = '0'
AND park_code = #{parkCode}
AND countycode = #{countycode}
AND DATE(pass_time) = CURDATE()
AND pass_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
AND pass_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN staff_type = '1' THEN 1 END) as registeredPersonnelCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN staff_type = '2' THEN 1 END) as visitorPersonnelCount FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.rysstxsj
deleted = '0'
AND park_code = #{parkCode}
AND countycode = #{countycode}
AND DATE(pass_time) = CURDATE()
AND pass_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
AND pass_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

SELECT park_code, (COUNT(*) > 0) AS has_clsstx, COUNT(*) AS totalVehicleTraffic, SUM(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS generalCargoCount, SUM(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hazardousTransportCount, SUM(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS smallVehicleCount, SUM(CASE WHEN vehicle_type = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS emergencyVehicleCount FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.clsstx WHERE deleted = '0' AND park_code IN #{c} AND pass_time >= #{startTime} AND pass_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY park_code

SELECT park_code, (COUNT(*) > 0) AS has_rysstx, SUM(CASE WHEN staff_type = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS registeredPersonnelCount, SUM(CASE WHEN staff_type = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS visitorPersonnelCount FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.rysstxsj WHERE deleted = '0' AND park_code IN #{c} AND pass_time >= #{startTime} AND pass_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY park_code

SELECT park_code, (COUNT(*) > 0) AS has_sbbjsj, SUM(CASE WHEN alarm_type = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alarm_intrusion, SUM(CASE WHEN alarm_type = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alarm_speed, SUM(CASE WHEN alarm_type = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alarm_help, SUM(CASE WHEN alarm_type = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alarm_stay, SUM(CASE WHEN alarm_type NOT IN ('1','2','3','4') OR alarm_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alarm_other FROM shipingtaishujuzhongxin.sbbjsj WHERE deleted = '0' AND park_code IN #{c} GROUP BY park_code
